text.insert: The product captures speech, preserves the original recognition, and produces cleaned text for insertion. Ford intends to stop using Wispr Flow and develop this fork as the replacement. The fork installs its app under the name Transcriber.
The permanent archive contains historical Wispr data and future Transcriber recordings, with raw and clean formats, every available source field, and attachments.

Archive data is a first-class dataset with its own manifest, source evidence, integrity reports, and Data page. Named curated collections were proposed during the audit but were not selected for this phase.
The archive has no artifact-size cap. It must keep oversized audio, unknown dates, malformed source IDs, and source versions rather than silently omit them.

The archive is a single-writer file dataset. Cloud synchronization, multiwriter coordination, curated dataset releases, continuous Wispr import, and changing the 180-second live recording limit are not implemented. The existing Wispr installation and nightly WisprSync export are unchanged.
